_comment: TF-1 — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every timeframe (unité de temps). Backend reads it via src/intelligence/timeframe_registry.py; the frontend consumes a GENERATED module (webapp/lib/timeframes.generated.ts via scripts/gen_timeframes.mjs) — never a hand-copied list. Adding a 7th unit = ONE edit here (+ regenerate). Every scattered enumeration (minutes/seconds/provider strings/labels/relevance/alignment subsets) derives from this. Order = the ladder order (fastest→slowest); neighbours (upper/lower) are derived from it. `perimeter`=tradeable unit; `reference`=served as a read-only reference series (W1); neither=known unit used only for conversions (M30). `sessionRelevant`/`prevLevelsRelevant`=false when a candle spans a whole day so the element must be hidden-with-mention (D1/W1).
